relations: The kettlebell presses against the green glass pane, producing cracks and white fragments at the contact point.
The glass pane rests on the hazard-taped frame, transferring the kettlebell's load to the supports.
As the glass fractures, shards and powder may detach and fall away from the pane.
The kettlebell stays in contact with the glass while the pane deforms and breaks beneath it.
